rows: The inline text to display. If there isn't enough space to render the text in a single line, it is truncated with an ellipsis and the full content is shown on pointer hover or keyboard focus.
The content of the tooltip shown when the text is truncated. By default, the tooltip content is the same as the `children` slot. Use only if the `children` slot may contain interactive elements.
